roadmap.title: Learn the Hunt
roadmap.description: Finish Trainee Mode, read the challenge panel, complete a first Bounty Hunt, secure a first enemy-Hunter kill, and let early Bloodline and gear progression develop.

roadmap.title: Controlled Bounty Hunt detours
roadmap.description: Use ordinary contracts for the no-clue boss locate, melee boss finish, instruments, outhouse, three-status setup, supply points, and every-location route.

roadmap.title: Build Hunters and combat counters
roadmap.description: Develop a survivor toward level 50 and 15 traits while accumulating monster kills, doors, chicken coops, Bloodline ranks, and the thrown-sledgehammer kill.

roadmap.title: Complete Soul Survivor wins
roadmap.description: Prioritize four fast rifts, activate a Wellspring with at least 250 energy, survive as carrier, and become the final living Hunter.

roadmap.title: Finish long account grinds
roadmap.description: Preserve five level-50 Hunters before retirement cleanup, then finish Bloodline Rank 100, roster recruitment, contracts, clues, PvP headshots, solo bosses, and 250 Soul Survivor rifts.

achievements.summary: Complete Trainee Mode by advancing the account to @mechanic{Bloodline Rank 11}.

guide.context: Bloodline Rank appears in the upper-right area of the main menu, and Trainee Mode ends when Rank 11 is reached.

steps.text: Finish the tutorial flow, then play contracts and earn account experience until Bloodline Rank 11 completes Trainee Mode.

achievements.summary: Earn account experience until @mechanic{Bloodline Rank 34} unlocks Bloodline Tier 2.

guide.context: Bloodline experience is account progression and continues across recruited Hunters and matches.

steps.text: Complete contracts, extract bounties, kill targets and monsters, and continue earning account experience until Rank 34 appears.

achievements.summary: Earn account experience until @mechanic{Bloodline Rank 67} unlocks Bloodline Tier 3.

guide.context: Bloodline progression is separate from an individual Hunter's level and persists when Hunters die or retire.

steps.text: Continue completing contracts, extracting bounties, and earning account experience until Bloodline Rank 67 appears.

achievements.summary: Earn account experience until @mechanic{Bloodline Rank 100}.

guide.context: Bloodline Rank 100 is the account-level cap for this achievement and can be reached across any mixture of Hunters and contracts.

steps.text: Continue earning account experience through contracts, targets, monsters, Hunter kills, and bounty extractions until Rank 100 appears.

achievements.summary: Retire 25 level-50 @npc{Hunters} through the roster Actions menu.

guide.context: The current retirement option appears only for a level-50 Hunter. Retirements are cumulative, but each retired Hunter leaves the roster permanently.

steps.text: After Five-Ace Hand is complete, raise a Hunter to level 50, select that Hunter in the roster, open Actions, choose Retire, confirm the retirement, and continue until 25 retirements register.

achievements.summary: Raise one living @npc{Hunter} to level 50.

guide.context: Hunter experience comes from monsters, enemy Hunters, Boss Targets, bounty extraction, and experience boons; if that Hunter dies, the character's level-50 attempt ends.

steps.text: Use one Hunter for repeated cautious contracts, earn experience, extract before excessive risk, and continue until the Hunter reaches level 50.

achievements.description: Have 5 level 50 Hunters at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep five different level-50 @npc{Hunters} in the roster at the same time.

guide.context: Retiring a level-50 Hunter removes that Hunter from the simultaneous roster count, so finish this achievement before beginning the 25-retirement cleanup.

steps.text: Level one Hunter to 50 and stop using that Hunter, then repeat the survival route with four additional Hunters until five level-50 Hunters occupy roster slots together.

achievements.description: Have 15 traits on a Hunter at the same time.
achievements.summary: Give one living @npc{Hunter} 15 traits at the same time.

guide.context: Traits can be bought with Upgrade Points or collected in missions; the Hunter must survive enough contracts to retain the complete set.

steps.text: Keep one Hunter alive through successful extractions, spend earned Upgrade Points on affordable traits, claim additional traits found during missions, and fill 15 trait slots simultaneously.

achievements.summary: Recruit a cumulative total of 100 @npc{Hunters}.

guide.context: The Hunters tab offers a free recruit or a paid Hunter with 10 initial Upgrade Points for 100 Hunt Dollars.

steps.text: Open the Hunters tab between matches, recruit the available free Hunter or a paid Hunter, clear roster space when necessary, and continue until 100 recruits register.

achievements.description: Complete your first Bounty Hunt contract.
achievements.summary: Complete one @mechanic{Bounty Hunt} contract by extracting with a Boss Target's Bounty Token.

guide.context: This first successful contract also supplies the first entry toward Centennial Contractor's 100-contract total.

steps.text: Queue for Bounty Hunt, locate and kill a Boss Target, banish the target, collect a Bounty Token, and remain inside an extraction zone until extraction finishes.

achievements.displayName: In the Footsteps of Flaxman Low
achievements.summary: Investigate a cumulative total of 250 @item{clues} in Bounty Hunt.

guide.context: Each standard Bounty Hunt route offers clues at compounds, and clue progress accumulates across contracts.

steps.text: Travel to compounds, approach and investigate each clue, and continue across contracts until 250 clue investigations register.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 @mechanic{Bounty Hunt} contracts by extracting with at least one Bounty Token.

guide.context: Clues investigated during these contracts also advance In the Footsteps of Flaxman Low, while solo Boss Target kills advance Lone Wolf.

steps.text: Queue for Bounty Hunt, kill and banish a Boss Target, collect a Bounty Token, extract alive, and continue successful bounty extractions until 100 contracts register.

achievements.description: Locate a Boss Target without investigating a clue.
achievements.summary: Locate a @enemy{Boss Target} compound in Bounty Hunt without investigating any clue during that mission.

guide.context: Inside the correct compound, Dark Sight makes the Boss Target icon pulse; entering and identifying the compound is sufficient without beginning the boss fight.

steps.text: Start Bounty Hunt, avoid every clue interaction, search compounds while using Dark Sight, and enter the compound where the Boss Target icon begins pulsing.

achievements.summary: Close a cumulative total of 250 @item{rifts} in Soul Survivor.

guide.context: A single Soul Survivor match allows at most four rift closures, so the achievement requires at least 63 matches.

steps.text: Queue for Soul Survivor, travel to rifts, finish closing each rift, and continue across matches until 250 closures register.

achievements.description: Absorb at least 250 energy from the Wellspring in Soul Survivor.
achievements.summary: Activate the @mechanic{Wellspring} while at least 250 energy remains and personally absorb 250 energy.

guide.context: Wellspring energy drains while the carrier survives; activating too late leaves fewer than 250 points available for the achievement.

steps.text: Activate the Wellspring while at least 250 energy remains, then stay alive as the carrier until 250 energy has been absorbed.

achievements.description: Be the first to activate the Wellspring in Soul Survivor.
achievements.summary: Become the first Hunter in a @mechanic{Soul Survivor} match to activate the Wellspring.

guide.context: Rushing rifts from the start also builds progress toward Sealed and Secured while creating the earliest Wellspring opportunity.

steps.text: Queue for Soul Survivor, sprint between rifts, keep closing rifts ahead of every opponent, and become the first Hunter to activate the Wellspring.

achievements.summary: Survive a @mechanic{Soul Survivor} match as the Wellspring energy reaches zero.

guide.context: Other players are eliminated while the Wellspring carrier absorbs the remaining energy, so the carrier must stay alive for the entire drain.

steps.text: Activate the Wellspring, defend the carrier position from every opponent, and remain alive until all Wellspring energy is absorbed.

achievements.description: Be the last Hunter standing in Soul Survivor.
achievements.summary: Become the last living Hunter in a @mechanic{Soul Survivor} match.

guide.context: When every other Hunter is dead, the Wellspring drains rapidly; the requirement is elimination or death of all opponents rather than merely surviving the timer.

steps.text: Stay alive in Soul Survivor, eliminate opponents or let opponents kill one another, and ensure no other Hunter remains alive.

achievements.description: Kill an Immolator without making the Immolator explode.
achievements.summary: Kill one @enemy{Immolator} using only blunt damage so the Immolator never explodes.

guide.context: Bullets and knives rupture an Immolator; dusters and world hammers provide safe blunt damage.

steps.text: Approach an Immolator with dusters or a hammer equipped and use only blunt melee attacks until the Immolator dies without exploding.

achievements.summary: Kill 150 monsters with credited headshots.

guide.context: Grunts are abundant and have clear heads; a silenced firearm or bow reduces the sound made while farming the counter.

steps.text: Aim at the head of Grunts or other monsters, land the killing shot, and continue credited headshot kills until the counter reaches 150.

achievements.summary: Deal the killing blow to one enemy @npc{Hunter} in a live match.

guide.context: Training enemies and ordinary monsters are not enemy Hunters; the kill must be credited against another player.

steps.text: Find a live enemy Hunter, deal damage, and make the final attack deliver the credited kill.

achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemy @npc{Hunters} with credited headshots.

guide.context: Scoped rifles in Bounty Clash provide frequent engagements, while patient shots against stationary or peeking enemies improve headshot consistency.

steps.text: Enter live PvP modes, aim at enemy Hunters' heads, secure the final blow with the headshot, and continue until 100 headshot kills register.

achievements.description: Kill any Boss Target with a melee attack.
achievements.summary: Finish a @enemy{Boss Target} by making a close-range melee strike deliver the killing blow.

guide.context: World melee weapons and carried melee tools count, while Berserker can increase damage during the close-range finish.

steps.text: Weaken a Boss Target without killing the target, equip a melee weapon, then land the final attack at melee range.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy Hunter with a sledgehammer throw.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy @npc{Hunter} with a thrown @item{sledgehammer}.

guide.context: The Assailant trait enables the throw, and a sledgehammer is not normally lethal against a full-health Hunter, so the target should be weakened first.

steps.text: Equip Assailant, find a sledgehammer in a compound or supply area, weaken an enemy Hunter, then right-click with the sledgehammer so the airborne hammer deals the killing blow.

achievements.summary: Destroy 50 doors attached to buildings with charged melee attacks.

guide.context: A world hammer or axe usually breaks a wooden door in about two charged attacks, and Talon weapon variants also work.

steps.text: During contracts, use charged heavy attacks from a hammer, axe, or Talon weapon to destroy building doors until 50 destructions register.

achievements.summary: Burn 50 occupied @loc{chicken coops} by shooting each coop's hanging lantern.

guide.context: Coop spawn points are fixed but live chickens are random; a coop with dead or absent chickens may not provide credit.

steps.text: Search known chicken-coop spawn points, confirm live chickens are present, shoot the lantern hanging over the enclosure, and continue across missions until 50 coops burn.

achievements.description: Visit every location on any map in one mission.
achievements.summary: Enter the boundary of every named location on one map during a single mission.

guide.context: The initial spawn location does not credit automatically; leave that location's boundary and re-enter before following a route through the remaining named areas.

steps.text: Choose one map, re-enter the starting area's boundary after leaving it, then cross the boundary of every other named location before extracting or dying.

achievements.description: Visit every supply point on any map in one mission.
achievements.summary: Enter every standard @loc{supply point} on one map during a single mission.

guide.context: Supply points appear as small wagons or trolleys; event supply points may be additional, so visiting any event point on the route avoids a missed counter.

steps.text: Open the mission map, plan a route through every marked supply point, move into the center of each supply area, and visit any event supply point before the mission ends.

achievements.description: Play the gramophone and the piano in one mission.
achievements.summary: Activate one @item{gramophone} and one @item{piano} during the same mission.

guide.context: Both instruments spawn inside or around compounds, and the two interactions may occur at different compounds before extraction or death.

steps.text: Search compound buildings during one mission, use the Play interaction on a gramophone, then use the Play interaction on a piano before the mission ends.

achievements.description: Be on fire, poisoned, and bleeding at the same time.
achievements.summary: Make the Hunter suffer @warn{burning}, @warn{poison}, and @warn{bleeding} at the same time.

guide.context: The three effects can be self-inflicted in a quiet area; a fresh disposable Hunter limits the cost if the combined damage becomes fatal.

steps.text: Place a poison trip mine and a bear trap close together, trigger both traps to gain poison and bleeding, then ignite the Hunter at the edge of a fire bomb while both earlier effects remain active.

achievements.summary: Finish one objective listed in the main-menu @mechanic{Challenges} panel.

guide.context: Challenges commonly ask for monster kills or damage against enemy Hunters with specified weapon or ammunition categories.

steps.text: Open the Challenges panel, select an unfinished objective, meet the displayed requirement in live matches, and return to the menu after the challenge completes.

achievements.summary: Complete seven standard objectives from the right-side main-menu @mechanic{Challenges} list.

guide.context: Update 2.8's chapter-based Story Challenge is a separate onboarding system; use the ordinary Challenges list whose completions accumulate across several weeks.

steps.text: Check the ordinary right-side Challenges list before each session and finish its monster-kill or Hunter-damage objectives until seven completions register.

achievements.summary: Enter a compound @loc{outhouse}, close the door, and remain hidden until the achievement unlocks.

guide.context: Outhouses are the small freestanding toilets found around compounds; standing nearby or leaving the door open does not satisfy the hiding condition.

steps.text: Open an outhouse door, step fully inside, close the door from within, and wait several seconds.

achievements.summary: Make 50 separate @item{gear pieces} available through account progression.

guide.context: Most gear unlocks arrive automatically through Bloodline progression, so the counter advances alongside the rank achievements.

steps.text: Keep gaining Bloodline ranks until the fiftieth gear piece becomes available.

achievements.summary: Kill 150 @enemy{Grunts} with @item{dusters}.

guide.context: Grunts are the common humanoid monsters throughout every map, making quiet dusters kills easy to combine with clue and exploration routes.

steps.text: Equip dusters, use charged blunt attacks to finish Grunts during contracts, and continue until 150 dusters kills register.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 @enemy{Boss Targets} while queued without teammates.

guide.context: Solo credit requires entering the contract alone. Two Sticky Bombs quickly damage most bosses, but the Assassin can shed attached explosives while transforming into insects.

steps.text: Queue for Bounty Hunt as a solo Hunter, locate and kill Boss Targets without teammates, and continue solo boss kills until the counter reaches 50.
